external_dictionary_review.notes: Independent external lexical review remains separate. Generation-stage senses below are constrained to repository lexicon meanings and common contemporary media contexts.

freshness_method: Guarded promotion checks all selected IDs against canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-42 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: an editor who reviews and prepares material for publication
journalistic or relating to news writing
truthfulness or fidelity to what the evidence supports
recorded data used for comparison or analysis
a file containing stored records or data
a visual image or captured view used as a source
oral or spoken rather than written
testimony or a witness account of an event
sending or transmission of a written message
continuous prose text rather than a fragment or isolated phrase
alert or warned to exercise attention/caution
notorious or having a strongly negative reputation
frightening, dreadful, or emotionally severe as a descriptor

generation_guardrails: P1-P5 introduce exactly three new targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all fifteen.
All six passages retain ten questions and ten linked answers and remain within the 220-320 whitespace-token B1 band.
Learner-facing title, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Media scenarios distinguish evidence, source limits, headline wording, data presentation, witness accounts, and commentary.
Loaded labels are analyzed rather than endorsed; factual claims are fictional or generic unless independently verified.
Guarded promotion fails closed on target-ID freshness collisions, schema drift, QA-link errors, script leakage, first-introduction collisions, or state mismatch.
Generation/integrity status remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
